entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding, you're speaking with Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie, I'm calling about an order I received a few weeks ago. I'd like to return a pair of cycling shoes.
I can certainly help with that. To pull up your account, could I please get your name and order number?
Yes, the name is Sam Jones, and the order number is VF-881-6234.
Thank you, Sam. I see the order right here, delivered 22 days ago. Can you tell me, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a sizing and preference issue?

It's the fit. I've taken them on two rides, and they've given me some really nasty blisters on my heels. I tried adjusting the cleats and wearing different socks, but they're just not right for my feet.

I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just take a quick look at the return policy for these cycling shoes. One moment, please.
Okay, thanks for your patience. I've confirmed that these shoes fall under our 90-day return policy. Since you're well within that window, I can go ahead and authorize a full refund for you.

That's great, I appreciate it. Since I have to go through the trouble of sending these back and they caused a bit of an issue with the blisters, would it be possible to get a discount code for a future purchase? Or perhaps have the return shipping covered?

I understand the request, Sam. While our policy requires the customer to cover return shipping on items that aren't defective, I can process the return authorization immediately so you can get your refund as quickly as possible. I'm sending the email with the return label instructions to you right now.
Okay, that's fair enough. I was hoping for a little something, but getting the refund processed quickly works for me. Thanks for your help.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the shoes at our warehouse, your refund will be issued to the original payment method. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you, Charlie.
My pleasure. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
